summary: Scaling duelist who is weak at levels 1–3 and dangerous once she has items. Her trades come from wall-dash E stuns and true-damage second Q. Punish her early, and stay away from walls when E is up.
threats: Q (Precision Protocol): a second Q after a short delay deals bonus true damage.
W (Tactical Sweep): the outer edge of the cone slows you and heals her.
E (Hookshot) grapples a wall, then dashes off it; it stuns if it hits you.
R (Hextech Ultimatum) at 5 locks you in a zone with her, cutting off escape.

matchups.why: Renekton's early burst out-trades Camille at levels 1–3, when she has no items. He can zone her off farm and snowball before her scaling kicks in.
trading: E in, W stun, Q, then E back out. Get your trade done before her second Q is ready.
Walk inside her W cone, not on its outer edge, to avoid the slow and heal.
Don't fight near walls when her E is up.
Use full Fury for empowered W when she commits.
matchups.early: Levels 1–3 are your window. Trade aggressively and deny her farm.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R makes your all-in stronger, but her R traps you. Fight in open space.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and crash for plates while she's weak.
matchups.jungle: She escapes with E off walls. Gank in the middle of the lane, away from walls.

matchups.why: Darius out-damages Camille early with Hemorrhage stacks, and E pull stops her hookshot escapes. She can't trade with him before items.
trading: E (Apprehend) pull her when she E's off a wall toward you.
Stack Hemorrhage with autos and W before she can disengage.
Stay inside her W cone to avoid the slow and heal.
Walk away from walls she could hookshot off.
matchups.early: Bully her at levels 1–3 and look for an all-in at 3+ stacks.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R resets on kill. Her R can trap you, so fight in the open.
matchups.jungle: She escapes with E. Gank away from walls.

matchups.why: Riposte parries Camille's E stun and turns it back on her, but her true-damage Q and shield trade well against Fiora. Even matchup decided by who uses their key spell first.
trading: Hold W (Riposte) for her E stun. A parried Hookshot leaves her stunned and in vitals range.
Lunge onto vitals and get out before her second Q (true damage) is ready.
Stand away from walls when her E is up; she needs one to hookshot.
Step inside her W cone, not on the edge, to avoid the slow and heal.
matchups.early: Even. She's weak at levels 1–3, so trade when your W is up and her E is down.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R heal zone wins extended fights, but her R traps you with her. Keep W for after the R lands.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and fight in cooldown windows, away from walls.
matchups.jungle: She escapes with E off walls. Gank in the middle of the lane, away from terrain.

matchups.why: Camille's second Q is true damage that ignores Malphite's armor, and her passive shield blocks his poke. She out-trades him and scales better.
trading: Q (Seismic Shard) her when she walks up; it's targeted and can't be dodged.
E (Ground Slam) slows her attack speed during trades, which weakens her Q2 follow-up.
Don't trade into her shield; poke once to make her passive pop first.
Stand away from walls when her E is up; she needs one to hookshot onto you.
matchups.early: Farm and poke safely. You won't win extended trades against her true damage.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R gives your jungler a lockdown. She's slippery without it.
matchups.wave: Let her push and farm under tower; build health, not just armor.
matchups.jungle: Gank away from walls; your R makes her escape harder.
matchups.build: Aftershock or Grasp. Health items; armor alone doesn't stop true damage.
